info.title: Cinema Booking System API
info.description: API documentation for Cinema Booking System

put.description:
Requires inventory:write.

The seat must be AVAILABLE and expiresAt must be in the future.
The showtime must be OPEN_FOR_BOOKING and start in the future.
Its room and cinema must both be active.

Returns HTTP 409 with INVENTORY_SHOWTIME_NOT_BOOKABLE
when showtime eligibility is not satisfied.

This endpoint does not reuse an existing HELD seat.

get.description:
Requires inventory:manage.
Matrix layouts expose matrix with dimensions and occupied cells.
Legacy layouts expose geometry in seats and elements.
Matrix cells are independent of booking availability.

404.description: Room or layout not found

put.description:
Requires inventory:manage.
Replaces content of a DRAFT layout.
Matrix layouts accept expectedVersion and matrix.
Legacy layouts accept expectedVersion, seats and elements.
The two representations are mutually exclusive.
expectedVersion refers to layout.version, not layoutVersion.
Saving matrix content does not create or modify catalog seats.
Legacy layouts cannot be converted in place.

409.description: Layout is not DRAFT or expectedVersion is stale

404.description: Room or layout not found

get.summary: Get ticket category definitions of a pricing policy
get.description:
Requires inventory:manage.
Supports FARE_MATRIX_V2 policies only.
Returns stored category definitions and policy metadata.
Does not verify customer eligibility or publication readiness.

404.description: Policy not found in this cinema

409.description: Unsupported pricing model

put.summary: Replace ticket categories of a draft pricing policy
put.description:
Requires inventory:manage.
Supports FARE_MATRIX_V2 drafts only.
expectedVersion refers to policy.version, not policyVersion.
Replaces the complete category catalog.
An empty array clears the catalog.
Category IDs are regenerated.
Returns the catalog with updated policy metadata.

Fare rules, dimensions and holiday dates are preserved.
Category references in fare rules are not checked by this operation.
Eligibility rule codes are declarations, not verification results.
Does not evaluate prices or authorize publication.

404.description: Policy not found in this cinema

409.description: Wrong model, non-draft policy or stale expectedVersion
This endpoint supports BASE_RULES_V1 policies only

put.summary: Replace all surcharge rules of a draft pricing policy
put.description:
Requires inventory:manage.
expectedVersion refers to policy.version, not policyVersion.
Replaces every surcharge rule; an empty array clears them.
unit, stackable and priority must be supplied explicitly.
Rule IDs are regenerated.
Published policies cannot be modified.
Base price rules and holiday dates are preserved.
This operation does not evaluate prices.
Movie attribute and showtime format codes are draft configuration;
their runtime support is not verified by this operation.

get.summary: Get pricing seat definitions and physical mappings
get.description:
Requires inventory:manage.
Supports FARE_MATRIX_V2 policies only.
Returns stored definitions ordered by code.
Does not validate fares or publication readiness.

404.description: Policy not found in this cinema

409.description: Unsupported pricing model

put.summary: Replace pricing seat definitions of a draft policy
put.description:
Requires inventory:manage.
Supports FARE_MATRIX_V2 drafts only.
expectedVersion refers to policy.version, not policyVersion.
Replaces the entire seat type catalog.
An empty array clears the catalog.
Definition IDs are regenerated.

Codes must be unique after normalization.
Each physical seat type may map to at most one pricing code.
UNCONFIRMED requires a null physicalSeatType.
CONFIRMED requires a non-null physicalSeatType.

Fare rules, categories, dimensions and holidays are preserved.
Fare rule references are not checked by this operation.
A confirmed mapping does not confirm fare units,
pair charging, surcharge rules or publication readiness.

400.description: Invalid data, duplicate code or duplicate physical mapping

404.description: Policy not found in this cinema

409.description: Wrong model, non-draft policy or stale expectedVersion

get.summary: Get declared sale scopes of a V2 pricing policy

404.description: Policy not found in this cinema

409.description: Unsupported pricing model

put.summary: Replace sale scopes of a V2 draft
put.description:
Requires inventory:manage.
expectedVersion refers to policy.version, not policyVersion.
Replaces all sale scopes. An empty array clears the catalog.
IDs are regenerated. Duplicate codes or dimension tuples are rejected.
References are reviewed separately; incomplete drafts may be saved.
Fare rules and other catalogs are preserved.
Does not validate full coverage or authorize publication.

404.description: Policy not found in this cinema

409.description: Wrong model, non-draft policy or stale version

get.summary: Get holiday dates of a pricing policy
get.description: Requires inventory:manage. Dates use the policy time zone.

put.summary: Replace holiday dates of a draft pricing policy
put.description:
Requires inventory:manage.
expectedVersion refers to policy.version, not policyVersion.
Dates must be unique and within the policy effective period.
An empty array clears the holiday calendar.
Published policies cannot be modified.
Base price rules are preserved.
This operation does not evaluate prices.

get.summary: Get stored cinema fare matrix configuration
get.description:
Requires inventory:manage.
Supports FARE_MATRIX_V2 policies only.
Returns policy metadata, day groups, time bands,
fare rules and policy holiday dates.
amountVnd is an integer VND amount encoded as a decimal string.
policy.version is the optimistic-lock token;
policy.policyVersion is the business policy version.
Empty arrays represent missing configuration, not free tickets.
Does not evaluate fares, verify eligibility,
validate publication readiness or produce a booking quote.
Does not include a V2 surcharge model.

404.description: Policy not found within the requested cinema

409.description: This endpoint supports FARE_MATRIX_V2 policies only

put.summary: Replace a draft cinema fare matrix
put.description:
Requires inventory:manage.
Supports VND FARE_MATRIX_V2 drafts only.
expectedVersion refers to policy.version, not policyVersion.
Atomically replaces all day groups, time bands and fare rules.
All three arrays are required; empty arrays clear those sections.
Each fare must reference dimension codes from this request.
Dimension and fare IDs are regenerated.
Holiday dates are preserved.
amountVnd must be a canonical integer VND JSON string.
Returns updated policy metadata with the new lock version.
Does not validate matrix coverage, overlaps, eligibility,
publication readiness or booking prices.

200.description: Matrix replaced; updated policy metadata returned

400.description: Invalid request, dimensions, references or fare data

404.description: Policy not found within the requested cinema

409.description: Wrong model, non-draft policy or stale expectedVersion

get.description:
Requires inventory:manage.
Returns policy metadata, base price rules, holiday dates
and surcharge rules from one consistent policy version.
This operation does not validate publication readiness
or evaluate prices.

409.description: This endpoint supports BASE_RULES_V1 policies only

put.summary: Replace all base price rules of a draft
put.description:
Requires inventory:manage.
 expectedVersion refers to policy.version, not policyVersion.
 Replaces every base price rule; an empty rules array clears only the base price rules.
 Holiday dates and surcharge rules are preserved.
 Rule IDs are regenerated.
 Published policies cannot be modified.
 Returns the complete policy content after saving.
 This operation does not publish or evaluate ticket prices.

post.summary: Create a showtime and generate its seats
post.description:
Requires showtime:manage.

When roomLayoutId is supplied, it must identify a
PUBLISHED layout belonging to roomId.
Seats are generated from that layout's snapshots.
Active seats start AVAILABLE; inactive seats start UNAVAILABLE.

roomLayoutId is required when the room has any
PUBLISHED matrix layout.
Omitting it in that case returns
INVENTORY_SHOWTIME_LAYOUT_REQUIRED.

When the room has no published matrix layout,
omission retains legacy active-catalog-seat generation.

The server does not automatically select the latest layout.
Seat prices are calculated from basePrice using SeatPricingPolicy.
The pinned layout cannot be changed after creation.
Existing showtimes are not migrated by this operation.

409.description: Layout selection required, selected layout is not published, room or cinema inactive, schedule overlap or seat-generation conflict

get.summary: Get room layout metadata by room
get.description:
Returns all layout versions, newest first.
Returns an empty array when the room has no layouts.

404.description: Room or layout not found

post.description:
Creates an empty DRAFT layout.
Send only roomId to create an empty 6x6 matrix.
An explicit matrix may specify rowCount and columnCount,
but its seats array must be empty.
Legacy canvasWidth and canvasHeight remain supported.
Legacy dimensions and matrix are mutually exclusive.
The backend assigns layoutVersion.
This operation does not publish or bind the layout to showtimes.

409.description: Room layout version limit reached

404.description: Room or layout not found

post.description:
Requires inventory:manage.
expectedVersion must match the current version field.

Matrix layouts:
- require at least one seat.
- validate dimensions, consecutive numbering and occupied cells.
- COUPLE occupies two adjacent columns.
- preserve every supplied seatId after checking its room.
- create an inventory seat for each unbound cell.
- never infer seat identity from its display number.
- do not require a stored SCREEN element.
- do not modify metadata of existing inventory seats.

Legacy layouts:
- require at least one seat and one SCREEN.
- validate rotated geometry inside the canvas.
- reject seat-seat and seat-element overlaps.

Seat binding and publication share one transaction.
Published layouts cannot be modified.
Publication does not change existing showtimes.

The response contains layout metadata.
Reload layout content after publication to obtain bound seatIds.

409.description: Layout is not DRAFT or expectedVersion is stale

404.description: Room or layout not found

post.summary: Create a draft from a published matrix layout
post.description:
Requires inventory:manage.
The source must be a PUBLISHED matrix layout.
expectedVersion refers to the source version field,
not layoutVersion.

Creates a new DRAFT in the same room.
Copies matrix dimensions, positions, numbers and seat types.
Preserves every inventory seatId.
Creates new layout-cell records without creating inventory seats.

The backend allocates the next room layoutVersion.
The source layout and existing showtimes remain unchanged.
Returns the complete content of the new draft.

Legacy geometry layouts are not converted by this operation.
Repeating a successful request creates another draft.

201.description: Draft copied from the published matrix

409.description: Stale source version, source is not a published matrix, inconsistent source content or version limit reached

404.description: Room or layout not found

get.description: Requires inventory:manage. Returns newest policyVersion first.

post.summary: Create a cinema pricing policy draft
post.description:
Requires inventory:manage.
The server assigns policyVersion and snapshots the cinema time zone.
The cinema must have a configured time zone.
Creates metadata only; no price rules are created or published.
Repeating a successful request creates another draft.

post.summary: Review selected configuration issues of a draft policy
post.description:
Requires inventory:manage.
expectedVersion refers to policy.version, not policyVersion.
Returns errors and warnings without modifying the policy.

Equal-priority overlaps are potential conflicts, not proven
highest-priority ambiguities.
Full price coverage and customer eligibility are not verified.
publicationValidated is always false.
A report without errors does not authorize publication.

post.summary: Review selected configuration issues of a draft fare matrix
post.description:
Requires inventory:manage.
Supports FARE_MATRIX_V2 drafts only.
expectedVersion refers to policy.version, not policyVersion.

Reviews required data, fare units, effective periods,
unused dimensions, holiday configuration and ticket categories.
Reports empty category catalogs, unconfirmed category eligibility
and fares referencing unknown category codes.
Unused categories and unverified eligibility rules produce warnings.

Returns at most 200 issues.
hasErrors includes errors beyond the response limit.

Does not evaluate full policy coverage, highest-priority ambiguities,
category sale scope, eligibility rule implementations,
customer evidence, surcharge behavior or business confirmation.
publicationValidated is always false.
A report without errors does not authorize publication.
Does not modify the policy.

200.description: Review completed; configuration errors are included in the report

404.description: Policy not found in this cinema

409.description: Wrong model, non-draft policy or stale expectedVersion

post.summary: Simulate one fare selection using a draft matrix
post.description:
Requires inventory:manage.
Supports VND FARE_MATRIX_V2 drafts only.
expectedVersion refers to policy.version, not policyVersion.
Uses the policy time zone and holiday calendar.

First-showing and eligibility inputs are hypothetical.
Room, movie, physical seat compatibility and customer
eligibility are not verified.

Returns MATCHED, GAP or AMBIGUOUS with highest-priority winners.
Equal-priority winners remain ambiguous even when amounts match.
MATCHED does not confirm the fare unit or publication readiness.

Does not calculate additional surcharges, produce a booking
quote, authorize payment or modify stored configuration.

404.description: Policy not found in this cinema

409.description: Wrong model, non-draft policy, stale version or date outside policy period

post.summary: Analyze draft fare coverage within one local-day window
post.description:
Requires inventory:manage.
Supports VND FARE_MATRIX_V2 drafts only.
scenario.expectedVersion refers to policy.version.
scenario.startsAt selects the date in the policy time zone.
fromMinute and toMinute define a half-open local clock window.

All other scenario conditions remain fixed across the window.
First-showing and eligibility inputs are hypothetical.
Returns MATCHED, GAP or AMBIGUOUS segments.
Equal-priority winners remain ambiguous even when prices match.
Flags cover the complete analysis; at most 200 merged segments return.

This is local wall-clock analysis, not validated scheduling instants.
Does not establish full policy coverage or publication readiness.
Does not verify eligibility, calculate additional surcharges,
produce a booking quote or modify stored data.

404.description: Policy not found in this cinema

409.description: Wrong model, non-draft policy, stale version or date outside policy period

post.summary: Simulate one base ticket price using a draft policy
post.description:
Requires inventory:manage.
The policy must be DRAFT.
expectedVersion refers to policy.version, not policyVersion.

Uses the policy time zone and holiday calendar.
Membership and channel values are hypothetical simulation inputs.
Customer eligibility is not verified.
Surcharges are not included.
The result is not a booking quote and cannot authorize payment.

This operation does not modify the policy.

404.description: Policy not found in this cinema

409.description: Stale version, policy not draft, date outside effective period, no matching rule or ambiguous highest-priority rules

post.summary: Analyze draft base prices within one local-day window
post.description:
Requires inventory:manage.
expectedVersion refers to policy.version.
startsAt identifies the local date in the policy time zone.
fromMinute and toMinute define a half-open local-time window.

Returns MATCHED, GAP or AMBIGUOUS intervals.
Membership and channel inputs are hypothetical.
Surcharges and customer eligibility are not evaluated.
This is wall-clock rule analysis, not a list of valid scheduling instants.
publicationValidated is always false.
No policy data is modified.

patch.summary: Update only the inventory seat active state
patch.description:
Requires inventory:manage.
Supports both legacy catalog and layout-managed seats.
The seat must belong to the supplied roomId.

Sets active to the requested value.
Repeating the same request leaves the same active state.

Does not require or modify seat numbers, row labels or types.
Does not modify layout cells or published snapshots.
The active state belongs to the physical seat and is shared
by every layout referencing the same seatId.

Does not change existing ShowSeat statuses or bookings.
For newly generated show seats, the existing generation
rules use the inventory seat's active state.

Reload the published room matrix after a successful update.

400.description: Invalid UUID, missing roomId or missing active

404.description: Seat not found in the supplied room

get.summary: Get the pinned seat map of a showtime
get.description:
Public read API.

Positions, seat numbers and seat types come from the
showtime's pinned published layout.
Price and status come from ShowSeat.

When matrix is non-null:
- matrix contains the complete row and column counts.
- seats contain zero-based rowIndex and columnIndex.
- number is the consecutive seat number within its row.
- seatNumber is the display label, such as A1.
- columnSpan is 2 for COUPLE and 1 for other seat types.
- each COUPLE seat appears once at its starting cell.
- missing cells are empty spaces, not seats.
- the screen is displayed above the matrix.
- canvas dimensions and seat geometry are null.
- elements is an empty array.

When matrix is null, use the legacy canvas dimensions,
seat geometry and layout elements.

Missing ShowSeat yields null showSeatId, price and status,
with selectable=false.

selectable also requires the showtime to be eligible
for booking. HELD seats are not automatically released.

No booking-owner information is returned.
Reading the map does not reserve seats.

404.description: Showtime not found

409.description: Missing pinned layout, unpublished layout or inconsistent seat map

get.summary: Get bookable showtimes for a cinema
get.description:
Returns future OPEN_FOR_BOOKING showtimes in active rooms
and an active cinema.

The time interval is [from, to).
from and to must include an ISO-8601 offset.
movieId is optional.

OPEN_FOR_BOOKING does not guarantee available seats.

200.description: Matching showtimes, or an empty array

400.description: Invalid query parameters or time range

get.summary: List legacy catalog seats for inventory management
get.description:
Omit active to include both active and inactive catalog seats.
Layout-managed seats are read from the published room matrix API.
Omit active to include both active and inactive rooms.

404.description: Room or layout not found

get.summary: Get a published room matrix for administration
get.description:
Requires inventory:manage.

roomId is required.
When layoutId is supplied, it must belong to roomId
and identify a PUBLISHED matrix layout.

When layoutId is omitted, selects the PUBLISHED layout
with the greatest layoutVersion in the room.
Draft layouts do not affect this selection.
A legacy geometry layout is rejected rather than converted.

Matrix dimensions preserve empty rows and columns.
Seat positions, numbers and types come from layout cells.
Active state comes from the inventory seat.

Each COUPLE seat appears once at its starting cell
with columnSpan=2 and capacity=2.
Missing cells are empty spaces, not inventory seats.
Display the screen above the matrix.

This API does not return prices or booking availability.
It does not change any showtime's pinned layout.

404.description: Room not found, no published layout, or selected layout does not belong to the room

409.description: Selected layout is not published, is a legacy geometry layout, or contains inconsistent matrix data

get.description: Omit active to include both active and inactive cinemas.

roomLayoutId.description: Published layout pinned when the showtime was created.

anyOf.description: Inventory seat identifier; null while the draft cell is unbound

seatId.description: Inventory seat identifier; null while the draft cell is unbound

columnIndex.description: Zero-based starting column. COUPLE also occupies the next column in the same row.

number.description: Consecutive seat number within the row, starting at 1. COUPLE counts as one seat.

seatType.description: Defaults to STANDARD. COUPLE occupies two columns; all other types occupy one.

ReplaceRoomLayoutContentRequest.description:
Replaces draft content.
Supply matrix for matrix layouts or empty legacy drafts.
Legacy drafts containing seats or elements cannot be converted.
Supply seats and elements for legacy geometry layouts.
The two representations are mutually exclusive.
expectedVersion refers to layout.version.

RoomLayoutMatrixInput.description: Sparse room matrix. Each seat is represented once at its starting cell. COUPLE occupies two adjacent columns; other types occupy one. Do not submit an additional seat for the second COUPLE cell.

anyOf.description: Inventory seat identifier; null while the draft cell is unbound

seatId.description: Inventory seat identifier; null while the draft cell is unbound

columnIndex.description: Zero-based starting column. COUPLE also occupies the next column in the same row.

number.description: Consecutive seat number within the row. COUPLE counts as one seat.

seatType.description: COUPLE occupies two columns; all other types occupy one.

RoomLayoutContentResponse.description:
Administration content of one layout version.
Matrix layouts expose matrix.
Legacy layouts expose geometry in seats and elements.

matrix.description: Present for matrix layouts; absent for legacy geometry layouts

RoomLayoutMatrixResponse.description: Sparse room matrix. Each seat appears once at its starting cell. COUPLE occupies two adjacent columns without an additional seat entry for the second cell.

layoutVersion.description: Layout revision number within the room; not the optimistic lock version

publishedAt.description: Absent while the layout is a draft

version.description: Optimistic lock version used as expectedVersion when saving or publishing

timeZone.description: Region-based time zone supported by the server. Omission or null preserves the current value. Blank values are rejected.
Null means the cinema time zone is not configured.

eligibilityRuleCode.description: Required only for RULE_REQUIRED. Declaring a code does not verify its implementation.

policyVersion.description: Business policy version within this cinema.

pricingModel.description: Immutable pricing model, separate from both version fields.

CinemaPricingTicketCategoriesResponse.description: Stored ticket category definitions for one pricing policy. Does not verify customer eligibility or publication readiness.

physicalSeatType.description: Required for CONFIRMED; must be null for UNCONFIRMED. Mapping does not determine fare units or surcharges.

CinemaPricingSeatTypesResponse.description: Stored pricing seat definitions and physical seat mappings for one policy. Does not validate prices, fare units or publication readiness.

amountVnd.description: Canonical non-negative integer VND string. Maximum value: 9223372036854775807.

roomLayoutId.description: Published layout belonging to roomId. Required when the room has a published matrix layout. Otherwise omission retains legacy catalog generation. The server does not automatically select a layout.

CreateRoomLayoutRequest.description:
Creates an empty draft.
Omit canvas dimensions and matrix to create an empty 6x6 matrix.
Legacy canvas dimensions and matrix are mutually exclusive.

CopyPublishedRoomLayoutRequest.description: Creates a new matrix draft from a published layout. expectedVersion refers to the source layout's version field.

expectedVersion.description: Expected source layout version, not layoutVersion.

timeZone.description: Region-based time zone supported by the server. Optional during migration; omission leaves it unconfigured.

effectiveFrom.description: Inclusive first local date in the policy time zone.

effectiveTo.description: Exclusive ending local date. Null means no ending date.

pricingModel.description: Immutable pricing model. Omission or null retains BASE_RULES_V1 compatibility. FARE_MATRIX_V2 creates metadata only until its rule APIs are implemented.

publicationValidated.description: Always false. This report does not authorize publication.

startsAt.description: Hypothetical start time with ISO-8601 offset.

simulatedReleaseDate.description: Hypothetical official release date used by draft simulation. The server derives advance screening from the show date in the policy time zone. This date is not verified against Movie Service.

simulatedEligibilityCodes.description: Hypothetical satisfied eligibility codes. Omission means none are satisfied.

amountVnd.description: Non-negative integer VND amount serialized as a decimal string to preserve precision.

additionalSurchargesEvaluated.description: Always false. No additional surcharge calculation is performed.

scenario.description: Fixed simulation conditions. startsAt selects the local date in the policy time zone; its time does not set the window.

localWallClockOnly.description: Always true. Segments describe local clock minutes, not validated scheduling instants.

startsAt.description: Hypothetical showtime start with an ISO-8601 offset.

simulatedMemberTiers.description: Hypothetical membership codes for simulation only. Omission means no membership conditions are satisfied.

simulatedChannel.description: Hypothetical sales channel code. Omission matches only channel-unrestricted rules.

simulation.description: Always true for this draft preview.

includesSurcharges.description: Always false; surcharge calculation is not included.

eligibilityVerified.description: Always false; customer eligibility is not verified.

bookingQuote.description: Always false; this result cannot be used as a booking quote.

UpdateSeatActiveRequest.description: Updates only the physical inventory seat's active state. Does not modify layout snapshots or existing show seats.

SeatActiveStateResponse.description: Current active state of a physical inventory seat.

label.description: Omitted when the layout element has no label.

ShowtimeSeatMapResponse.description: Seat map from the showtime's pinned published layout. When matrix is non-null, use matrix dimensions and seat cell positions instead of legacy geometry.

canvasWidth.description: Legacy canvas width; null for matrix layouts.

canvasHeight.description: Legacy canvas height; null for matrix layouts.

matrix.description: Matrix dimensions; null for legacy geometry layouts. The screen is displayed above the matrix.

ShowtimeSeatMapSeatResponse.description: One inventory seat. COUPLE appears once and occupies two columns. Missing cells are empty spaces, not seats.

anyOf.description: ShowSeat identifier; null when ShowSeat is missing.

showSeatId.description: ShowSeat identifier; null when ShowSeat is missing.

x.description: Legacy geometry; null for matrix layouts.

y.description: Legacy geometry; null for matrix layouts.

width.description: Legacy geometry; null for matrix layouts.

height.description: Legacy geometry; null for matrix layouts.

rotationDegrees.description: Legacy geometry; null for matrix layouts.

anyOf.description: Price from ShowSeat; null when ShowSeat is missing.

price.description: Price from ShowSeat; null when ShowSeat is missing.

anyOf.description: Stored ShowSeat status; null when ShowSeat is missing.

status.description: Stored ShowSeat status; null when ShowSeat is missing.

rowIndex.description: Zero-based matrix row; null for legacy layouts.

columnIndex.description: Zero-based starting column; null for legacy layouts.

number.description: Consecutive seat number within the row; null for legacy layouts.

columnSpan.description: Occupied columns: COUPLE=2, other types=1. Null for legacy layouts.

PublishedRoomSeatResponse.description: One bound inventory seat at its starting matrix cell. A COUPLE seat appears once and occupies two columns.

number.description: Consecutive seat number within the row.

seatNumber.description: Display label from the layout, such as A1.

rowLabel.description: Row label: A through Z, then AA, AB and so on.

active.description: Current inventory active state. This is not showtime booking availability.

RoomPublishedSeatMapResponse.description: Published matrix used to display room seats in administration. Seat labels, positions and types come from the layout. Active state comes from the inventory seat.

CinemaFareMatrixResponse.description: Stored FARE_MATRIX_V2 configuration. Does not evaluate prices or validate publication readiness.
